title: QNB Corp. 8-K Filing — Completion of Acquisition of The Victory Bancorp, Inc.
summary: QNB Corp., a Pennsylvania regional bank holding company, completed its previously announced merger with The Victory Bancorp, Inc. on April 1, 2026. Victory merged into QNB with each Victory share converted to 0.5500 QNB shares, and Victory's bank subsidiary merged into QNB Bank. Two Victory executives were appointed to the QNB board, including a new Vice Chairman role created via bylaw amendment.
key_points: QNB Corp. completed acquisition of Victory Bancorp effective April 1, 2026
Conversion ratio: 0.5500 shares of QNB common stock per share of Victory common stock
Victory Bank merged into QNB Bank (wholly-owned subsidiary of QNB Corp) immediately following parent-level merger
Joseph W. Major and Kevin L. Johnson appointed to QNB board; Major named Vice Chairman and Chair of Strategic Planning Committee
Consulting and non-competition agreement with Mr. Major valued at $665,865 over 24 months
Company bylaws amended to formalize the Vice Chairman of the Board role
